text: Works great. Works great to keep my food from splattering

product_metadata.title: Magnetic Microwave Cover for Food Microwave Splatter Cover 11 12 Clear Plate Dish Covers for Microwave Oven Cooking Anti-Splatter Guard Lid with Steam Vents BPA Free Large | Black
features: KEEPS MICROWAVE CLEAN - Prevents splatter during microwave cooking and conveniently stows on the inside ceiling when not in use, ready when you need it! Easy grip handles make for easy use and steam vents allow moisture to escape.

ACCOMMODATES MOST MICROWAVES - Double check that the inside of your microwave oven has a flat metal ceiling. You can then further pre-test for assured success before purchasing by touching any magnet to the center area of your microwave ceiling to see if it sticks.

COVERS PLATES & BOWLS - Hover Cover is large enough to cover dinner plates, dishes, and bowls. Hover Cover measures 12 inch x 11 inch x 3.25 inch and fits perfectly inside most microwave ovens, including smaller microwaves.
BPA-FREE/FULLY TESTED - Food Safe BPA-free material is microwave safe withstanding temperatures up to 300°F and passes the BUREAU VERITAS product safety test.
FRIENDLY CUSTOMER SERVICE - Dislike? Unsatisfied? No worry. Whatever the problem we will give you a satisfactory solution. We aim to provide 100% customer satisfaction!
